_comment: One contract, three parsers: src/lib/links/anchors.ts (desktop TS), src-tauri/src/parse.rs parse_anchors (desktop Rust index) and apps/server/src/markdown/sections.ts (MCP). Each case lists every heading (level, text, 1-based line) and every block id (id, 1-based line of the block's FIRST line). `candidates` (desktop only) lists the first lines of id-less blocks.
